description:
The office controls which houses and collections the storefront features, replacing hardcoded slug arrays.

Epic: _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/epics.md (Epic 7)
Architecture: _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/architecture.md
Requires: W1 merged
Blocks: nothing

userStories.title: Migration: featured_rank on brands and collections
userStories.description: As the office, I want to choose what the storefront features, in an order I control.
acceptanceCriteria: featured_rank integer NULL on both tables, with a CHECK that it is null or positive
NULL means not featured
The migration seeds the storefront current hardcoded choice so nothing moves on deploy
The seeding UPDATE matches on (brand_slug, slug) PAIRS — collection slugs are unique per brand, never globally
A test with two houses sharing a collection slug proves only the intended one is featured
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Admin patch support and whole-list reorder endpoints
userStories.description: As the office, I want to set and reorder the featured lists.
acceptanceCriteria: featured_rank joins the brand and collection update whitelists
It is absent from create — a house is not featured at birth
An explicit null clears it, distinct from an absent key
PUT /admin/brands/featured takes slugs; PUT /admin/collections/featured takes brand+slug PAIRS
An unknown slug returns 422 naming it, never a silent drop
Each is one transaction that clears then re-applies
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Public read-model ordering
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want the featured houses and collections first.
acceptanceCriteria: ORDER BY featured_rank ASC NULLS LAST, name ASC, id ASC — deterministic even with duplicate ranks
No unique index is added
Featuring interacts correctly with trade_only: a featured house a guest cannot see leaves no hole
featured_rank is exposed on both public read models
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Seed test: featured survives a reseed
userStories.description: As the office, I want my featuring decision to outlive a catalogue reseed.
acceptanceCriteria: featured_rank is absent from the upsert DO UPDATE set lists
A test seeds, features a house, reseeds and asserts the rank is unchanged
The test names the same posture as trade_only, inventory and shipping_rates
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: CRM featured panel
userStories.description: As the office, I want to reorder featuring without a developer.
acceptanceCriteria: Ordering logic is pure in featuredOrder.js with a .test.js sibling
Move up and down behave correctly at the ends; duplicates are impossible; the list is capped
A standing note states that featured houses appear on /brands immediately while featured collections appear at the next site build
Gates green: `( cd atelier-crm && npm test && npm run build )`

userStories.title: Storefront homepage reads featured
userStories.description: As the office, I want the homepage to follow my choice.
acceptanceCriteria: FEATURED_COLLECTIONS, FEATURED_SLUG and LATEST_SLUGS are gone
The hero takes the first three featured collections in rank order
A featured collection with no committed artwork renders a defined fallback, never a broken image
The page keeps prerender = true and the build still survives an API outage via safeFetch
Gates green: `( cd atelier-storefront && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build )`

userStories.title: Storefront brands page reads featured
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want the In focus strip to reflect the office choice, not a derived guess.
acceptanceCriteria: The In focus strip reads featured_rank instead of the is_international and design-count heuristic
The full directory below stays alphabetical
The artwork fallback chain applies here too
Gates green: `( cd atelier-storefront && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build )`
